scope: Read-only public ESPN source verification; source observations, not an NBA roster guarantee or prediction. No database or infrastructure access.
coverage: The full 30-team directory and two selected-team roster responses were checked. Every source-listed athlete in each response is preserved; the application loads only the team drawn, not all 30 rosters.
freshness: Original observation and provider timestamps travel with cached projections. Stale data is labeled; source availability and transaction timing are not guaranteed.
runtimeCheck: Node 24 built-in fetch with the existing environment proxy (NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 for QA child only) returned HTTP 200 / 30 teams. This QA process variable is not added to application or deployment configuration.
